current.text: Dallas is short on true ball handlers. Kyrie Irving, rookie Sergio de Larrea and Sasser are its only real guards, and most of the roster is forwards.
Nick expects Sasser to get a chance at a bigger role in Dallas.
Josh does not have Sasser in his projected starting five. That five is Kyrie Irving, Max Christie, Cooper Flagg, P.J. Washington and Morez Johnson Jr.
Dusty May is the new Dallas head coach, so the rotation is not settled yet.
Dallas plays 4 games in each of our fantasy playoff weeks (4-4-4). It also has the league-high 16 back-to-backs.

durable.text: Sasser is an undersized 6'1 guard who can go on hot shooting streaks.
Josh thinks Sasser is not a good player.
In his small role he is far below the top 250 pool in points, rebounds and steals.

note: Sasser is not a draft pick for us. Both sites value him at 0 USD, with ranks of 395 on Yahoo and 316 on ESPN, and he went undrafted in our league last season. In 12.1 minutes a game last season he gave only 5.2 points and 0.5 steals. Early in the season, check whether Dusty May hands him the backup guard minutes on a thin guard depth chart. If he gets them, Dallas's 4-4-4 playoff schedule could make him a late-season streamer.
